title.narrative: GRCF2 W2 E2 - Dushanbe Riverside West Avenue

description.narrative: The provision of a sovereign loan of up to €30 million to the Republic of Tajikistan to finance improvements of public transport infrastructure in the riverside area of Dushanbe (the project). The project consists of: (i) the reconstruction of roads and a bridge over the Varzob river, (ii) the provision of infrastructure for sustainable mobility, including dedicated bus/trolleybus lanes, infrastructure for active mobility (walking and cycling) and electric mobility. The Project will facilitate the City of Dushanbe (the City or client) to enhance the transportation infrastructure, notably through the promotion of sustainable mobility options, and provision for electric vehicle charging infrastructure. The Project is a second follow-on investment under the Dushanbe Green City Action Plan (GCAP). In addition, the project is anticipated to create positive impacts by catalysing fundamental shift in transportation habits i encouraging transition from private vehicles to sustainable modes of mobility. The project's objective is to transform one of the city's avenues into a model for sustainable mobility. This will result in a notable enhancement in environmental conditions, marked reductions in air and noise pollution, and a significant decrease in greenhouse gas emissions. By doing so, the project aims not only to contribute to environmental sustainability but also to mitigate the impacts of climate change.
